note: Worst observed wall time for a stage-guarded test under a stated external load, on a stated tree. These are recorded measurements, not designed budgets: the margin they imply is contention margin, and tools/gate_attr_readings.py recomputes it against the TIMEOUT the build tree declares, so raising the timeout moves the margin instead of leaving this number to mean 'enough'.
